description: Within each (subject_id, label) group, windows are sorted by source_file and window_index, shuffled with the fixed seed, and assigned 70/15/15. Windows are non-overlapping 5 s windows.
notes: Same 60 subjects appear in train/val/test by design; do not apply the subject-disjoint leakage check.
Residual temporal correlation between adjacent non-overlapping windows remains a disclosed caveat.
Use features/windows.csv as the source of truth; do not glob data/windows.
